listing.short_description: Keep belongings, receipts and warranty details beautifully organised on your device.
listing.long_description:
Possessory helps you keep household belongings, receipts and warranty details organised on your device.

Create rooms and record your belongings with photos, purchase details, serial numbers and warranty dates. Attach receipt images or PDFs and review suggestions from on-device English text extraction. Schedule maintenance tasks and opt in to warranty reminders.

Search and filter your inventory, then export PDF, CSV or JSON records. Save ZIP backups, with optional password protection, and restore records after reviewing the import.

Core inventory functions work offline and no account is required. Speech input depends on your device provider and may use an internet service. Reports are user-maintained records and are not insurer-certified valuations.

This engineering preview allows one household and up to 30 belongings. Premium purchasing is unavailable until release configuration and purchase verification are completed.
feature_bullets: Organise household belongings by room with photos and purchase details.
Keep receipts, warranty dates and maintenance tasks together.
Review on-device English receipt text extraction before applying suggestions.
Export PDF, CSV and JSON records, or save optional password-protected backups.
Use core inventory functions offline without creating an account.
